strategy.title: No plan until the NFPA 25 workbook's price is settled: the record says both $750 and $75
strategy.why: The only opening's card carries priceCents 75000 ($750) while its EVIDENCE price fact says $75. The two contradict each other by 10x, so no price is established. At $750, 6 sales (about 40 contacts at the measured 18/120 rate, from 180 reachable firms) would reach $4,000; at $75 the whole reachable market yields about 27 sales, about $2,000, short of the target. Which one is true decides whether any plan exists.

Sell NFPA 25 inspection report and deficiency-tracking workbook for fire sprinkler inspection firms to each buyer.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN with OFFER_AND_PRICE as the decisive link is correct. The card's priceCents is 75000 ($750) while its EVIDENCE price fact is $75: the record contradicts itself 10x, so no purchase price is established and the plan correctly refuses to pick one. The price decides the outcome: at $75 the target needs 54 sales (4,000 / 75 = 53.3) but the 180-firm roster at the recorded 15% yields ~27, i.e. ~$2,025 at most, so the target is out of reach; at $750 six sales ($4,500) suffice. Brain's MARKET_VOLUME failure (reads $75) agrees with the $75 branch. Nothing unknown is treated as known: price is UNKNOWN, no cash is booked, the research step is zero-cost.
findings: Population double-count: conversion is 18 agreements from 120 contacts, and the roster holds 180 firms, so only ~60 firms are uncontacted. At $75 the remaining market is ~60 x 15% = 9 sales (~$675), even further short than the $2,000 stated; at $750 the 60 uncontacted firms give ~9 sales ($6,750), still enough. The re-plan must count only uncontacted firms, plus whatever the 18 existing agreements actually paid.

Resolution path: the card's agreements list is empty, so 'checking the 18 recorded agreements' may find no record to read. If the source records cannot settle the price, the fallback should be a zero-cost live offer at $750 to the uncontacted firms (a CONDITIONAL plan with proof/stop/continue deciding OFFER_AND_PRICE), not an open-ended wait.
If the 18 agreements were at $750 and are unpaid, they are themselves $13,500 of potential receipts and must be recorded as agreements on the card before re-planning.
